records.quote: lex, it-gis, f. [perh. SaDscr. root lag-, lig-,  to fasten; Lat. ligo, to hind, oblige; cf reli-  gio], a proposition or motion for a law made

2. lego, legi, lectum (^gn, plur. part.  legentum, Ov. Tr. I, 7, 25), 3, v. a. [Gr. Xe-yw,  \6yor, Ao-ydr, etc - Lat.legumen, di-leg ens,  neg-leg-o, etc • cf. Germ, lesen], to bring to-  gether, to gather , collect. I, L i t. In

note: cx-leg 现为 rx-lect 的 legacyId（form lect，gloss choose/gather/read）。L&S 同时支持两义：lex, legis "a law"（词源 "perh. Sanscr. root lag-, lig-, to fasten; Lat. ligo"），lego, legi, lectum "to bring together, to gather, collect"。关键点：L&S 把 lex 归到 lag-/lig-「系、缚」根而非 lego「读」，因此词库 note 说 lex（法）与 legere 同形异源，与 L&S 一致。
